Name: Mobile Phone Reskin Mod
Author: SilentResident
Description:
A simple mod which provides theme and wallpaper replacements (reskins) for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url] / [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21017]Mobile Phone Continued[/url] mods. It also provides icon replacements for a number of phone applications as well. My mod's goal is to make the mobile phone match visually the Stardew Valley's graphics style (pixelated art). This allows for a more seamless visual integration of these mods in the game.

This mod, aside from providing reskins for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url] mod (which is outdated; it is recommended to use the updated version at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21017]Mobile Phone Continued[/url] instead), also provides re-made application icons for the following mods (if installed[b]):

[/b][list]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6215]Custom Reminders[/url][/b]
[*][b][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11325]Email App[/url]﻿[/b][/b]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5803]JoJa-84-Plus - in-game calculator[/url]﻿[b][b][/b][/b][/b]
[*][b][b][/b][/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6601]Mobile Calendar[/url]
[*][b][/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6543/]Mobile Catalogues[/url]﻿
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6575]Mobile Television[/url]﻿[b][b][/b][/b][/b]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6840]Recurring Reminders[/url]﻿[/b]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19305]Schedule Viewer[/url]﻿[/b]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]﻿[/b] (the mobile app for it, can be found at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url]'s Download section)
[*][b]﻿﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4]CJB Cheats Menu[/url]﻿ [/b](the mobile app for it, can be found at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url]'s Download section)
[b]
NOTE: Updated versions for most of these applications, are now available at the download page of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21017]Mobile Phone Continued[/url], under the "OPTIONAL FILES" section!
[/b][/list]
If you like any of the reskins/icons provided with my mod, then feel free to install them, [i]after[/i] you have the respective mod installed. For example, to use the Calculator's icon provided with my mod, make sure you have installed the [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5803]JoJa-84-Plus - in-game calculator[/url]﻿[/b] mod first, and then install my mod over it to overwrite its files. And so on.


That is, to install the mod, just extract the archive's contents into your Mods folder which is located inside your game's installation directory and overwrite where asked. Of course, not everything has to be extracted; only those app icons which suit your preferences. Enjoy!

Downloads.Description: Version 1.5 adds support for two new mobile phone applications: Email and Schedule Viewer.
